items.item: One trigger that delegates to a handler class (no logic in the trigger body)
items.evidence: trigger ContactTrigger on Contact (after insert, after update) { ContactTriggerHandler.updateAccountLastContactDate(Trigger.new, Trigger.oldMap); }

items.item: Bulkified: collects Account Ids, one query and one DML for the whole batch, no SOQL or DML inside a loop
items.evidence: It collects Account Ids in a Set and does a single `update accounts;` with no SOQL or DML in a loop. But it has no query at all, so 'one query' isn't met.

items.evidence: public without sharing class ContactTriggerHandler; no USER_MODE or stripInaccessible found
